messages.subject: Re: Problem with the *xlsx* and *xlsxjars* Packages on CRAN with R 2.15
parts:
Hi John, 

Please try to install from source.  It should work. 

Get the latest .tar.gz file, and then from R,

install.packages("xlsx_0.4.2.tar.gz", type="source")
Let me know if you run into issues. 

Best, 
Adrian



On Sat, May 12, 2012 at 11:35 PM, John Ramey <john...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi, Adrian.

I am emailing to let you know that your *xlsx* and *xlsxjars* packages
have failed to build on CRAN with R 2.15. I have used the *xlsx*
package a lot in the past, and I heavily rely on the *ProjectTemplate*
package, which depends upon the *xlsx* package.

Here is a link to the log file for the *xlsx* package build error:
http://www.r-project.org/nosvn/R.check/r-release-macosx-ix86/xlsx-00check.html

Similarly, here is a link to the log file for the *xlsxjars* package:
http://www.r-project.org/nosvn/R.check/r-release-macosx-ix86/xlsxjars-00check.html

At both sites, there is a link that indicates the details of the build
errors. It appears that the culprit is the following error:

Java for ppc cannot run in this configuration.
Please consult documentation.
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'xlsxjars', details:
 call: .jinit()
 error: Cannot create Java virtual machine (-1)
Error: loading failed

I hope that helps resolve the issue. Let me know if I can be
assistance in fixing it.

Thank you for your time.
